fact_text: Bank loans to individuals in Pakistan fall under consumer financing rules, which cover personal consumption such as cars, homes, solar systems and personal loans, but not financing a business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: To borrow for a business in Pakistan, the owner must register as a business (sole proprietorship, partnership, limited company or corporate) and is then assessed under SME or corporate lending rules.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Bank auto financing under consumer rules is capped at PKR 3 million (Rs 30 lakh) per vehicle, for new or used cars, and the buyer must contribute at least 30% of the vehicle's value.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Auto loan tenor in Pakistan runs about three to five years, and the exact term depends on the car's engine capacity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: The PKR 3 million auto financing cap was introduced because the market was becoming highly consumption-driven; the bank executive said he would not take a position on whether the cap is right.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Salaried borrowers typically provide three months of salary slips and six months of bank statements, with contractual staff providing six months of salary slips, plus CNIC copies and two references.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: For a business borrower, a bank judges the loan on the business's cash flow generation and on collateral it is comfortable with, since the financed asset alone may not cover a failed business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: A bank treats a rental-car business's loan as serviceable because it knows roughly what one car earns each month and what its net expenses are, so it can estimate the cash left to repay the instalment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Who holds the title to a financed car depends on the structure: under ijarah the bank owns it and leases it, under diminishing musharakah the buyer is named on the title, and under conventional loans the buyer owns it directly.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Home financing in Pakistan typically runs for 10 to 20 years, and the maximum tenor is set by the borrower's age.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Home loans in Pakistan require the buyer to contribute between 20% and 40% of the property value, depending on the house price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Home loan age limits are 21 to 65 years for salaried borrowers and up to 70 years for business owners, because the age limit caps the repayment term.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Under diminishing musharakah, the bank and buyer co-own the property, and the buyer buys the bank's share in monthly units until becoming the full owner, with no maximum cap on the home loan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Unsecured personal loans in Pakistan can reach PKR 3 million and solar system financing up to PKR 5 million, and they are paid out as cash for personal consumption, not business use.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Overseas Pakistanis with a Roshan Digital Account can get auto financing at about KIBOR plus 1%, with no PKR 3 million cap and a longer tenor than locally resident borrowers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: The Roshan Digital Account overseas concession requires a monthly income of about USD 3,000 for salaried overseas Pakistanis and about USD 4,000 for business owners.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: An overseas Pakistani can be named as co-borrower on a family member's loan in Pakistan, and the bank assesses the overseas person's income as the financial strength behind the loan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Money brought in through a Roshan Digital Account and used to buy property in Pakistan can be remitted abroad at any time, which the bank executive called the biggest concession for overseas Pakistanis.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: The Roshan Digital Account programme has brought in over USD 10 billion of remittances into Pakistan, according to the bank executive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah offered app-based auto financing to about 1.5 million existing active customers, with approval said to take about five minutes, and planned to extend it to new customers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah's Alfa Mall marketplace sells products on a pay-later instalment plan, with zero markup on most items for holders of a Pakistani-issued credit card, and a service fee on higher-value goods.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah's app offers term deposit receipts with tenors from 7 days to one year, in Islamic and conventional forms, with annualised returns of about 8% to 11% depending on tenor.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: On early withdrawal from a term deposit receipt, the depositor gets back the principal plus the return for the nearest completed term, with no penalty, according to the bank executive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah's app also offers mutual funds in fixed income, money market and equity categories, plus Treasury bills and Pakistan Investment Bonds, which can be bought and redeemed through the app.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)

fact_text: Bank Alfalah offers a zero-markup ticket financing programme for travel, including Umrah, which the executive said was popular when airfares rose.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Investing, Leveraging, And More With Bank Alfalah's CDO Muhammad Yahya Khan | How to Money | Nukta' (YouTube, 2025-06-27)
